info.name: Zivdah API — Admin, User & Vendor
info.description:
All zivdah-api microservice endpoints, routed through the API gateway
(http://localhost:8001), covering all four roles enforced by the backend:
ADMIN, USER (customer), VENDOR (merchant) and DELIVERY_BOY.

Start with folder "0. Bootstrap" to register/login and populate
{{adminToken}} / {{userToken}} / {{vendorToken}} / {{deliveryBoyToken}}
automatically — every other request already references those variables.

Refreshed 2026-09-20 against the live controllers to add folder "9. Invoices"
(order-service's separate InvoiceController), a "Vendor Payouts" subfolder plus
gateway-status/webhook endpoints under "10. Payment Service", and the brand-new
"15. Chat Service" (bot + human support chat, incl. its WebSocket endpoint — see
that folder's description). Inventory Service's add/reserve/release/confirm
endpoints were also found to now require a role — previously open to any
authenticated user, tightened since this collection was last exported.

Requests flagged with ⚠ in their description hit endpoints where the live
backend currently has weaker auth than you might expect (missing
@PreAuthorize / ownership checks, or an unintentionally public route) —
they are included as-is to match the real API, not as a recommendation.

item.description:
Base path: /restful/v1/api/chat — zivdah-chat-service (added 2026-09-13), the 16th microservice: bot + human customer support chat. 4 REST controllers grouped into subfolders below.

This service also exposes a real-time WebSocket endpoint that a plain HTTP request can't drive — connect a WS client (Postman's own WebSocket request type, or wscat/websocat) to:
  ws://localhost:8001/restful/v1/api/chat/ws/chat/{{conversationId}}?token={{userToken}}
(swap ws-> wss and the host for prod). Auth is the JWT as a `token` query param, not an Authorization header — the handshake can't carry custom headers. Send JSON frames shaped {"type":"MESSAGE"|"TYPING"|"READ_RECEIPT","payload":{...}} — e.g. {"type":"MESSAGE","payload":{"message":"hi","messageType":"TEXT","clientMessageId":"c1"}}. Server-only frame types (PRESENCE/SYSTEM/ERROR) are rejected if a client sends them.

Fragile route-order gotcha (broke once, 2026-09-13): the gateway's WS route must stay declared before the general /chat/** route in application-{dev,prod}.yaml, or the general route silently wins and the handshake breaks.
